## Outcome

Describe the completed outcome. The PR title begins with the issue identifier (`#N: <title>`) and the body includes `Closes #N`.

## Evidence

- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] Replay and audit implications are documented.
- [ ] Schema or configuration version changes are explicit.
- [ ] Methodology changes cite their authoritative source.

## Risks and assumptions

List unresolved assumptions, failure modes, and any capital-safety implications. Use `None` only after considering them.
